title: Non-weakly regular self-dual generalized bent functions
summary: Determine the existence of non-weakly regular self-dual generalized bent functions in even dimension for primes congruent to three modulo four.

formal_statement.body: Does there exist any odd prime $p\equiv3\pmod4$, even positive integer $n$, positive integer $k$, and non-weakly regular self-dual generalized bent function $$f:V_n\longrightarrow\mathbb Z_{p^k}?$$ Give one witness anywhere in this admissible parameter domain, or prove global nonexistence over the domain.

scope.domain: Self-dual generalized bent functions over $\mathbb Z_{p^k}$
assumptions: $f$ is required to be generalized bent, self-dual, and non-weakly regular
scope.unresolved_remainder: No inspected later work gives even one compatible non-weakly regular self-dual generalized bent function in the admissible parameter domain or proves global nonexistence over that domain.

citations.locator: Conclusion, journal p. 4781, first further problem

progress.summary: The source asks whether non-weakly regular self-dual generalized bent functions exist for even n when p is congruent to three modulo four.
